en.quote: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
en.riddle: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
en.speaker: Achish

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָֽי
he.riddle: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָֽי
he.speaker: אָכִישׁ

en.15: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

he.15: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָֽי׃
